headlines.title: 玉渊谭天：中国央行立场文件旨在厘清汇率问题不应被政治化等问题
headlines.summary: 玉渊谭天发表文章称，中国人民银行发布关于人民币汇率的政策立场，核心在于厘清三方面问题：一是汇率问题不应被政治化，更不能被用作抹黑他国的工具；二是部分国际组织的相关评估并非成员国共同商定结果，本质上属于一家之言，不应被奉为“金科玉律”或选择性引用；三是个别国家不应将自身经济结构性问题归咎于他国，通过“甩锅”转移责任，而应正视并解决自身问题。

headlines.title_en: Yuyuantan: PBOC position paper aims to clarify issues such as exchange rates should not be politicized
headlines.summary_en: Yuyuantantian published an article stating that the People's Bank of China released a policy stance on the RMB exchange rate, with the core focus on clarifying three issues: first, exchange rate issues should not be politicized, let alone used as a tool to smear other countries; second, relevant assessments by some international organizations are not jointly agreed upon by member states and essentially represent a single viewpoint, and should not be treated as "gospel" or selectively cited; third, individual countries should not blame their own structural economic problems on other countries and shift responsibility through "scapegoating," but should face up to and resolve their own problems.

headlines.summary: 法国兴业银行的利率策略师在一份报告中表示，鉴于不确定性可能持续，法国政府债券（OAT）市场的主导力量预计将从外国投资者转向国内投资者。策略师表示：“尽管利差仍倾向于扩大，但这种趋势存在一定限度：投资者可能会低配法国资产，但不太可能完全退出法国国债市场。”与此同时，进一步加息的讨论远未尘埃落定。持续存在的通胀风险提醒市场，如果价格压力再次显现，各国央行仍可能需要进一步收紧货币政策。

headlines.title_en: Societe Generale: French government bond market may be dominated by domestic investors
headlines.summary_en: Societe Generale rate strategists said in a report that given the uncertainty may persist, the dominant force in the French government bond (OAT) market is expected to shift from foreign investors to domestic investors. The strategists said: "Although spreads still tend to widen, there is a limit to this trend: investors may underweight French assets, but are unlikely to completely exit the French government bond market." Meanwhile, discussion of further rate hikes is far from settled. Persistent inflation risks remind the market that if price pressures re-emerge, central banks may still need to tighten monetary policy further.

headlines.title: 十一假期上海链家二手房成交量同比增长44%
headlines.summary: 上海链家研究院数据显示，十一假期（10/1-10/7）上海链家的二手房成交量同比2025年十一假期增长44%，新房成交量增长64%。值得关注的是，带看量增幅低于成交量增幅，这一“剪刀差”释放出关键信号——当前购房者决策效率明显提升，观望情绪减弱，成交意愿较去年更为坚定。上海链家研究院认为，这说明在政策环境优化与价格预期趋稳的背景下，刚需与改善型需求正加速入场，市场信心修复进入实质性阶段。政策端持续释放的宽松信号，正逐步转化为真实的购买力，前期一系列限购松绑、信贷支持等措施的累积效应开始显现。

headlines.title_en: During the National Day holiday, Shanghai Lianjia second-hand home transactions rose 44% year-on-year
headlines.summary_en: Data from Shanghai Lianjia Research Institute shows that during the National Day holiday (10/1-10/7), Shanghai Lianjia's second-hand home transaction volume increased 44% year-on-year compared with the 2025 National Day holiday, while new home transaction volume increased 64%. Notably, the increase in property viewing volume was lower than the increase in transaction volume, and this "scissors gap" releases a key signal — current homebuyers' decision-making efficiency has clearly improved, wait-and-see sentiment has weakened, and transaction willingness is firmer than last year. Shanghai Lianjia Research Institute believes this shows that under the background of an optimized policy environment and stabilizing price expectations, rigid and upgrade demand is accelerating entry, and market confidence repair has entered a substantive stage. Continued easing signals from the policy side are gradually translating into real purchasing power, and the cumulative effects of a series of earlier measures such as relaxed purchase restrictions and credit support are beginning to show.

headlines.title: A股异动丨AI短剧概念股走强，芒果超媒涨超4%，中文在线涨超3%
headlines.summary: A股市场AI短剧概念股集体上涨，其中，新华传媒、上海电影10CM涨停，华策影视涨超6%，捷成股份涨超5%，芒果超媒涨超4%，国安股份、中文在线涨超3%。 消息面上，《参考消息》10月8日刊发香港《南华早报》网站报道《AI微短剧是中国下一波出口浪潮的试验案例》。在服务业领域，一场不易察觉的转变正在发生。今年前7个月，中国服务出口同比增长17.1%，其中个人文化和娱乐服务出口激增57.8%。中国服务贸易仍处于逆差状态，服务出口的体量远不足以替代制造业。不过，数字服务无需工厂、集装箱和港口即可在全球扩大规模。人工智能（AI）生成的微短剧是一个早期例证。

headlines.title_en: A-share movers | AI short-drama concept stocks strengthen, Mango Excellent Media up over 4%, Chinese Online up over 3%
headlines.summary_en: A-share AI short-drama concept stocks rose collectively, among which Xinhua Media and Shanghai Film hit the 10CM limit up, Huace Film & TV rose over 6%, Jebsen Shares rose over 5%, Mango Excellent Media rose over 4%, Guoan Shares and Chinese Online rose over 3%. In terms of news, Reference News published on October 8 a report from the Hong Kong South China Morning Post website titled "AI micro-dramas are a test case for China's next export wave." In the services sector, an imperceptible shift is taking place. In the first seven months of this year, China's services exports grew 17.1% year-on-year, with personal culture and entertainment services exports surging 57.8%. China's services trade remains in deficit, and the volume of services exports is far from enough to replace manufacturing. However, digital services can scale globally without factories, containers and ports. AI-generated micro-dramas are an early example.
